from tslearn.metrics import lb_keogh, lb_envelope

# Pattern 1: Compute envelope on the fly
dist1 = lb_keogh(ts_query=s1, ts_candidate=s2, radius=2)

# Pattern 2: Use pre-computed envelope
env_low, env_up = lb_envelope(s2, radius=2)
dist2 = lb_keogh(ts_query=s1, envelope_candidate=(env_low, env_up))

# Verify correctness
assert isinstance(dist1, float), "LB_Keogh distance must be a float"
assert dist1 >= 0.0, "LB_Keogh distance must be non-negative"
assert abs(dist1 - dist2) < 1e-9, "LB_Keogh distances with and without pre-computed envelope must match"

print(f"__CHECK__ lb_keogh {dist1:.4f}")
